narratives.Description: design(gates): under a recorded ceiling, no gate converts "cannot evaluate" into "pass"
narratives.Overview:
1. Recut P1: under a recorded presentation ceiling, the composite of required composed gates does not authorize a merge of a changed path those gates did not evaluate. Cannot-evaluate is refuse or escalate. This issue owns (a) intent-constraint N/A `skipped:true` when there is no production `.ts`/`.js`, and (b) observable-scope inferred-defaults-warn `code:0` of markup under an unset policy. Production `.ts`/`.js` no-new-facts (evaluate.ts 507-514) stays #4541. Do not absorb #4541. Do not widen `FACT_KINDS`.
2. Ceiling predicate: consume the #5056 presentation-ceiling artifact and its presentation-class set. Do not key on #4545 `matchedPhrase`. Do not mint a second ceiling store. Detector ownership stays on #5079 even when #5056 lands the out-of-class path boundary.
3. Arming is independent of #5056 item-6 purity. Any head restriction that is add-only or tightening against the merge base arms this compositor, whatever the rest of the diff contains. A head restriction arms but never admits: it is not continue evidence (item 6). Relaxation or removal authority is merge-base only; a head stamp cannot authorize weakening. Do not add the ceiling artifact to class-checks `DEFAULT_PROTECTED_GLOBS`. Off-ceiling means no merge-base artifact and no add-only or tightening head restriction. #5056 item 6 still governs that sibling gate's first-PR class-checks pass for a pure presentation change; this compositor does not inherit that purity test for arming.
4. Coverage is per changed path, not per gate exit. Under an armed ceiling each changed path must be (i) in a composed gate's analyzed set and evaluated, (ii) admitted by a recomputed closed-list rule, or (iii) refuse or escalate. A wrapper that remaps only `skipped:true` / `N/A —` cannot bind. Mixed `a.ts` + `b.sql` where only `a.ts` was analyzed does not admit `b.sql`.
5. Unknown-state must survive the CLI as a named-cause or non-zero required-check outcome. Grow `formatDegradedSkipReport` / orchestrator gate-outcome `skipped` rather than a new wrapper type around `task check`. CLI verbs today return only `result.code`; that is the hole.
6. Continue cites a merge-base human-stamped mint or allowance that covers the same paths, from a closed rule id the compositor re-runs. An attested string in the PR, brief, or commit is escalate, not continue. A head restriction is not a continue citation.
7. Escalate is exit 1 (or 2 under the #3282 degraded-skip convention) on a required composed gate, with the path list and gate ids derived by the gate. Unattended parks. Exit-0 notes, labels, or warn-only escalate are N/A renamed.
8. Closed composed-gate list is `REQUIRED_CONSUMER_ENFORCEMENT_GATES` (intent-constraint, observable-scope, class-checks, scope-provenance, evaluator-surface, test-boundary, consumer-check-contract). Name one unavoidable fail-closed merge check for an armed presentation ceiling, including consumer-check and rapid/pressure paths. Required-but-unrun is unknown. `architecture:sor-preflight` stays off this list unless this lean also adds it when a ceiling is present; default is leave SoR on #1481 / #5056 exemption-path boundary. Arming and weaken/remove refusal run in this compositor before any composed gate's N/A or skip short-circuit.
9. Presentation-extension set for the trigger matches the #5056 built-in set (`isMarkupPath` plus `.css`). Css-only under an armed ceiling is an explicit refuse or escalate row, not a silent continue.
10. Structured per-path coverage emit from each composed gate, read by the orchestrator. Do not extend the `soft_empty` stdout regex to `N/A —`.
11. Landing: #5079 consumes #5056's artifact schema and base-versus-head restriction compare. If #5056 has not landed, #5079 owns that compare over the same artifact (not a second store) until the sibling lands. Record the #5079 → #5056 landing edge on umbrella #5078 current-shape.
12. Tests lock: first PR that adds a head-only presentation restriction plus `public/index.html` refuses or escalates; first PR plus `src/View.tsx` the same; first PR plus `db/001.sql` refuses or escalates; first PR plus `src/save.ts` with no new FACT_KINDS refuses or escalates; same-PR weaken of a merge-base ceiling on a presentation-only diff (`src/View.tsx`) refuses even with a head stamp; class-checks does not fail a first PR solely because the ceiling artifact is unprotected; mixed `.ts` + `.sql` under an armed ceiling does not admit the `.sql` on a no-new-facts `.ts` pass; markup `.tsx` with unset observable policy under an armed ceiling is not warn-exit-0; continue without a recomputed merge-base admission rule refuses; css-only under an armed ceiling refuses or escalates; off-ceiling (no base artifact and no add-only or tightening head restriction) presentation-only N/A stays 0; production `.ts` skip/filter with no FACT_KINDS stays #4541 green; rapid/pressure still hits the compositor.

## Gate stamp

Round-1 ceiling is this write-back plus panel-deposit (spend N≥3). Families: grok, claude (opus), codex.

P1 is the composition rule itself: under a recorded presentation ceiling, every composed gate's cannot-evaluate state currently exits green, so the ceiling authorizes a merge of effects it cannot see. The issue owns that rule. #5056 and #5059 are instances; they do not absorb this charter.

What this P1 is not:

- #5056 P1: SQL, C#, and other production paths outside the built-in presentation extension set (wave-1 supplier-edge).
- #5080 / deferred #5059 P1: in-class durable-effect acquisition inside `.tsx` / `.jsx` / `.html`.
- #4541 in-language skip/filter leftover inside production `.ts`/`.js` adding no FACT_KINDS (sibling class, cited not absorbed).
- #4545 phrase→ceiling / untraceable-surface list.
- #4774 PR membership versus merge-base approved-scope.
- #5055 `verify:ac` admitted-source visibility.
- A request to widen intent-constraint languages or `FACT_KINDS`.
- Runtime containment (CSP, sandboxing).

Shape of the fix the arc may sharpen: under a recorded presentation ceiling, every composed gate's exits are refuse, continue citing the rule that admitted the change, or escalate to human review. N/A is abolished as a green state on this surface only. Off-ceiling behavior is unchanged. Escalations carry the evidence that triggered them.

## Pain

On the ceiling-gated surface, a gate that cannot evaluate a change exits green: intent-constraint prints `N/A — no changed production .ts/.js files` (exit 0), and scanner exemptions skip silently. An authorization claim (the ceiling) is enforced by gates whose unknown-state is "pass", so the claim launders effects it cannot see. Both #5056 and #5059 are instances; this issue owns the composition rule itself.

## Shape of the fix (for the arc to sharpen)

Under a recorded presentation ceiling, every composed gate's exits are: refuse, continue citing the rule that admitted the change, or escalate to human review. N/A is abolished as a green state on this surface only; behavior off-ceiling is unchanged. Escalations carry the evidence that triggered them.

## What this is not

Not #4541 (in-language skip/filter leftover — sibling class, cited not absorbed); not a recut of any bound gate; not a widening of FACT_KINDS or languages.

Refs umbrella #5078, #5056, #5059, #4541.
